title: StageLayoutActionOutcome
description: Successful result of a stage-layout action.

changed.description: `false` when no selected fixture had a resolvable position and nothing was written.

moved_fixture_ids.description: Selected fixtures whose stored position the action changed, in selection order.

replayed.description: `true` when idempotency replay returned the already committed authoritative result.

revision.description: Stage-layout object revision after the action (unchanged for a no-op).
